verdict.rationale: Rollbar's first-party docs describe registrable outbound webhooks that push data to any arbitrary external service. They fire on the same triggers as its other notification channels, and both the destination URL and the payload format (JSON or XML) are customizable for a custom tool or stack. A first-party Hookdeck guide shows these webhooks being consumed programmatically. Missing for 10: documentation of payload schema and event-type catalog, delivery guarantees (retries, signature verification), independent or hands-on corroboration.
